The proportion of premature deaths was greatest among AI/ANs (36.0%) and blacks (31.5%)
When premature death was examined by age-specific death rate, mortality increased with age
During 2001, of 700,142 deaths attributed to heart disease, 117,346 (16.8%) occurred among persons aged <65 years.
The proportions of premature heart disease deaths ranged from 12.4% in Rhode Island to 35.7% in Alaska
Hispanic whites (23.3%) had lower proportions than Hispanic blacks (27.5%)
CDC analyzed death certificate data for premature deaths from heart disease occurring in 2001.

methods_quotes.q: Proportions of premature death were calculated for all 50 states and DC.
